title.value: Current State and Future Directions for Learning in Biological Recurrent Neural Networks: A Perspective Piece
title.justification: The paper provides an in-depth perspective on learning in biological recurrent neural networks, discussing the state and future directions, without direct mention of climate change themes.
title.quote: Current State and Future Directions for Learning in Biological Recurrent Neural Networks: A Perspective Piece

extractions.description: The paper reviews biological learning in recurrent neural networks, comparing it with artificial neural network learning. It discusses synaptic plasticity, neural circuits, and temporal credit assignment, highlighting differences between biological and artificial systems. Recommendations are given for future research in neuroscience.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper's focus is on biological and artificial neural network learning mechanisms, specifically synaptic plasticity, neural circuits, and temporal credit assignment, rather than climate change.
climate_change_is_central.quote: We provide a brief review of the common assumptions about biological learning with findings from experimental neuroscience and contrast them with the efficiency of gradient-based learning in recurrent neural networks.
